title: Barber story: contractor and mercenary retrieval units competing

tellings.quote: also would explain the whole weird parts of the barber story where it's implies there's like contractor teams and mercenary you know you know like retrieval units all kind of competing over this stuff.

plain: Private contractor teams and hired mercenary units are said to compete with each other to recover crashed unknown craft. The commentator Matthew Pines raises this as one of the odder parts of the account given by a man named Jake Barber, who has told of taking part in such recoveries. If true, the recovery of these objects would not be in the hands of one government team alone.
